title: One-tap phone lessons verified
summary: Expand the phone explorer with immediate component lessons, assembly principles, connected-part navigation and offline practice in Arabic, French and English.

changes.detail: Assembly and placement content for 25 hardware topics, related component navigation, three lesson sections, an offline role quiz, progress and next-piece controls.
Single taps and component picker open the lesson immediately. Redesigned responsive lesson panel; AI teacher receives trusted assembly context.

validation.name: Lesson coverage and interaction tests
validation.detail: 7 phone tests passed. All 25 hardware topics have three-language assembly content and valid related parts. All 24 mapped families open with one click at two image sizes. Verified tabs, wrong/correct quiz feedback, related and next navigation, screen lesson without fabricated image crop, learned-state bridge, focus restoration, drag suppression, zoom, and AI context/bridges.

validation.name: History regression tests
validation.detail: 6 retention and interaction tests passed, including immutable append and archive recovery.

validation.name: Static validation
validation.detail: App TypeScript and focused ESLint checks passed. Focused tests and lint passed again after accessibility refinements.

validation.name: Local route
validation.detail: Current localhost:8082/phone-lab returned HTTP 200; local development server remains running.

validation.name: Reference review
validation.detail: Reviewed Apple iPhone 15 repair manual, camera, battery and haptic actuator references. The assembly section links to the model-specific manual and distinguishes illustrative lessons from real repair instructions.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: No visual browser or physical-phone QA was available. AI teacher routing and trusted context passed automated checks; live AI responses were not requested. No deployment.
